Prerequisite(s): Gunner 10

Benefit: The gunner gains Critical Focus as a bonus feat, treating her character level as her BAB for prerequisites. At 12th and 16th gunner levels, she may take this talent an additional time to gain a feat that has Critical Focus as a prerequisite, also treating her character level as her BAB for prerequisites. In addition, the gunner ignores the fighter level prerequisite for the Critical Mastery feat.
